title: Exotic Earthy Dutch Cheese Lasagna
description: A rich and adventurous Dutch dish featuring layers of lasagna, exotic cheeses, and earthy flavors, with a resinous and cheese-pull texture. This dish is perfect for those looking for a unique and exciting culinary experience.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the lasagna sheets according to package instructions.
In a pan, sauté the mushrooms, onion, and garlic in olive oil until the mushrooms are tender.
In a bowl, combine the smoked gouda cheese, goat cheese, and thyme.
In a salt-bake dish, create a layer of lasagna sheets.
Spread half of the cheese mixture over the lasagna sheets.
Add a layer of sautéed mushrooms and onion.
Repeat the layers, starting with the lasagna sheets, then the remaining cheese mixture, and finally another layer of mushrooms and onion.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and bake for an additional 10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
